title: Schedule
description: Starts the workflow on a recurring cron schedule.

cron.title: Cron expression
cron.description: When to run, as a six-field cron expression starting with seconds (for example 0 0 9 * * 1-5: 09:00 on weekdays).

timezone.title: Time zone
timezone.description: IANA time zone the schedule is evaluated in (for example Asia/Ho_Chi_Minh).
